items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Leonard Jones as the husband of 'Lu' (likely Lu Watters or a related figure in the conversation context), but Danny Barker does not respond with any personal connection or knowledge of Leonard Jones himself.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And years ago, she married Leonard Jones. Leonard Jones is her new husband.
Oh, that's wonderful. I wasn't aware of that. Was there anybody in your family that played music, Lu?
